newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT - Elektra started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Elektra started as buy.

text.p: Santander Investment began coverage of Mexican retailer Elektra with a buy recommendation.
Analyst Rolando Calderon said in a report on Monday that the company's total sales should grow by 25.1 percent in 1997 and 29 percent in 1998 in dollar terms.
"In 1997, we expect sales floor expansion of 19.3 percent, with same-store sales growth of 13 percent," he wrote.
Three Elektra stores have recently opened in Guatemala as part of a Central America expansion, he added.
Credit sales were also attractive, Calderon said, noting the company charges ten to 15 points above average credit rates.
Of seven Mexican retailers, the report showed Elektra the most profitable retailer and second-cheapest stock in the sample after Comerci.
The company's CPO shares stood up 10 centavos at 85.10 pesos in midday trading.
